task.description: WF-03 Step 1 for run WF03-GH804-20260816: root-cause diagnosis (diagnosis-as-design) for the TC-PRM-08-03 fixture seed mismatch (ISS-0713 / GH-804). SCOPE: test-code only; do NOT modify production src/definition/rollback.zig (that is GH-803/ISS-0712, separate run). Do NOT implement the fix yourself.
